title: Brock Purdy is on cusp of NFL record — if he can get past Broncos, Seahawks

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Brock Purdy is on cusp of NFL record — if he can get past Broncos, Seahawks
sources.description: The San Francisco 49ers quarterback was recognized as the NFC Offensive Player of the Month on Thursday, but that may feel like small potatoes in a couple weeks.
